verses.1: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song, a hymn in the assembly of the faithful.
verses.2: Let Israel be glad in their maker, the people of Zion rejoice in their king.
verses.3: Let them praise his name in festive dance, make music with tambourine and lyre.
verses.4: For the LORD takes delight in his people, honors the poor with victory.
verses.5: Let the faithful rejoice in their glory, cry out for joy at their banquet,
verses.6: With the praise of God in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hands,
verses.7: To bring retribution on the nations, punishment on the peoples,
verses.8: To bind their kings with chains, shackle their nobles with irons,
verses.9: To execute the judgments decreed for them - such is the glory of all God's faithful. Hallelujah!

notes.text: Make music with tambourine and lyre: the verse recalls the great exodus hymn of Exodus 15:20.
At their banquet: literally, "upon their couches." The people reclined to banquet.
The glory: what brings honor to the people is their readiness to carry out the divine will, here conceived as punishing injustice done by the nations.
